title: NgRx Small Examples
description: Use these small NgRx examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Describe an event with an action
examples.description: An action is a named message about something that happened.

examples.title: Put a value in an action
examples.description: props describes values carried by an action.

examples.title: Write a reducer rule
examples.description: A reducer takes the old state and an action and returns the next state.

examples.title: Register a root store
examples.description: provideStore connects reducer functions to root state keys.
examples.output: The reading key is handled by counterReducer in the application store.

examples.title: Read state with a selector
examples.description: A selector is a function that chooses a useful part of state.
examples.output: The selector returns 4 from the reading slice.

examples.title: Use a store value as a signal
examples.description: Store.selectSignal gives an Angular signal for a selected value.
examples.output: The paragraph follows the selected count from the registered store.

examples.title: Dispatch from a component
examples.description: A component can dispatch an action in response to a user action.
examples.output: The click sends bookRead to the store. A matching reducer can increase the count.

examples.title: Group related action names
examples.description: An action group keeps related event creators together.
examples.output: The generated addBook creator carries Moon Trip.

examples.title: Keep outside work in an effect
examples.description: An effect listens for actions and can return new actions after outside work.
examples.output: A loadBooks action is followed by booksLoaded with local sample data.

examples.title: Keep a normalised list
examples.description: A list with ids can be stored as an id array plus a lookup object.
examples.output: The lookup returns Garden Days for b2. NgRx Entity can manage this common shape in larger features.

examples.title: Try a SignalStore
examples.description: SignalStore is another NgRx way to organise state using Angular signals.
examples.output: The store exposes a count signal and an add method.

examples.title: Test a state rule directly
examples.description: A reducer can be tested without opening the page.
examples.output: Both checks pass: the result resets while the original state stays unchanged.
